entities.name: Inés Enríquez Frödden
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Inés Enríquez Frödden (1913–1998) was a Chilean politician. She became the first female Intendant in Chile in 1950, and the first female representative of the Lower House in 1951. She focused on the social rights of women and children.
